## AWS Service

**Service name:** (e.g., Amazon SQS, AWS Step Functions)
**Service category:** (Compute / Storage / Database / Networking / Security / Messaging / IaC / Observability / Other)

## Why?

What common tasks would this skill enable? Who benefits?

## Key Operations to Cover

List the most important CLI operations this skill should include:

- [ ] `aws <service> list-...`
- [ ] `aws <service> create-...`
- [ ] `aws <service> describe-...`
- [ ] `aws <service> delete-...`

## Are You Willing to Write This?

- [ ] Yes, I'd like to contribute this skill
- [ ] No, I'm requesting it for someone else to pick up

## Additional Context

Any relevant links, common workflows, or gotchas to be aware of?
